title: A house above the Atlantic
summary: Paço de Arcos · A spatial study traced from the main-floor plan and aerial photographs.
limitations: This is a hand-authored architectural approximation, not a survey or a photogrammetric reconstruction. All dimensions require review.
Room topology was traced from the linked archival floor plan. Its scale, date and agreement with the current building were not independently verified.
Only the main floor is reconstructed. The listing describes a lower floor and garage, but no lower-floor plan was available in the retrieved document.
Main roof outline and connected valleys were revised against the supplied overhead photograph. Roof pitch, height, junction dimensions and small details remain approximate.
Plot boundaries and slope are schematic; no cadastral or terrain measurements were available.
The listed 282 m² private / 327 m² built areas are source facts, not measurements of this model. The scene has not been fitted to those totals.
Furniture is simplified from photos; exact room-to-photo matches are uncertain. Office furnishing is illustrative.
The pool is shown with water for legibility although the photographs show it partly drained.
The linked video was inventoried but not watched. It did not inform this example.
